async function handlePingJson(req, res, send) {`
  try {`
    const body = await readJson(req);`
    return send(res, 200, { ok: true, received: body });`
  } catch (e) {`

AURUM é um **motor backend** para ingestão, normalização, análise e pontuação`

- Backend em Node.js (sem framework pesado)`

function NormHours($arr) {`
  $seen = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.HashSet[int]`
  foreach ($v in @($arr)) {`
    $n = [int]$v`
    if ($n -ge 0 -and $n -le 23) { [void]$seen.Add($n) }`
  }`
  $seen.ToArray() | Sort-Object`
}`
`

  $add = NormHours $hours`
`

  foreach ($h in @($add)) { [void]$set.Add([int]$h) }`
`
  $j.gapsByDay.$day.removedHard = $set.ToArray() | Sort-Object`
}`

function NormHours($arr) {`
  @($arr) |`
    ForEach-Object { `
      $n = [int]$_`
      if ($n -ge 0 -and $n -le 23) { $n }`
    } |`
    Sort-Object -Unique`
}`

`
$old = @'`
function classifyCertType(filename) {`
  const s = String(filename || "").toLowerCase();`
  if (s.includes("fgts") || s.includes("crf")) return "FGTS";`
  if (s.includes("cndt")) return "CNDT";`
  if (s.includes("cnd") || s.includes("receita") || s.includes("rfb")) return "CND";`
  if (s.includes("sefaz") || s.includes("estadual") || s.includes("icms")) return "SEFAZ";`
  if (s.includes("municip") || s.includes("iss") || s.includes("prefeitura")) return "MUNICIPAL";`
  return "OUTROS";`
}`
'@`
`
$new = @'`
function classifyCertType(filename) {`
  const s = String(filename || "").toLowerCase();`
`
  // específicos primeiro`
  if (s.includes("sicaf")) return "SICAF";`
  if (s.includes("ceis") || s.includes("cnep")) return "CEIS_CNEP";`
  if (s.includes("declar")) return "DECLARACOES";`
`

function _normHHMM(v){`
  const s = String(v||"").trim();`
  if (!s) return "";`

 * aceita: 21, "21", "21h", "21HS", "21:00", "21-00", "2100"`
 * retorna sempre "HH:MM" ou null`
 */`
function normalizeCloseHour(v) {`
  if (v === undefined || v === null) return null;`
  const s0 = String(v).trim();`
  if (!s0) return null;`
`
  const s = s0.toUpperCase().replace(/\s+/g, "");`
`
  if (/^\d{2}:\d{2}$/.test(s)) return s;`
`
  const mDash = s.match(/^(\d{2})-(\d{2})$/);`

function ReplaceExportedFunctionBlock($content, $fnName, $newBlock) {`
  $pattern = "(?s)export\s+async\s+function\s+$fnName\s*\([^)]*\)\s*\{.*?\n\}"`
  if($content -notmatch $pattern){`
    throw "Não achei o bloco da função: $fnName"`
  }`
  return ($content -replace $pattern, $newBlock)`
}`

$old = "(?s)function\s+parsePosInt\s*\(\s*v\s*,\s*def\s*,\s*min\s*,\s*max\s*\)\s*\{\s*.*?\n\}\s*"`

`
$new = @'`
function parsePosInt(v, def, min, max) {`
  const s = String(v ?? '').trim();`
  if (!s) return def; // ✅ evita Number('') => 0 quando v é undefined/empty`
`
  const n = Number(s);`
  if (!Number.isFinite(n)) return def;`
`
  const i = Math.trunc(n);`
  if (Number.isFinite(min) && i < min) return min;`
  if (Number.isFinite(max) && i > max) return max;`
  return i;`
}`
'@`

function Replace-FunctionBlock([string[]]$arr, [string]$fnName, [string[]]$newBlock) {`
  $start = -1; $end = -1`
`
  for ($i=0; $i -lt $arr.Length; $i++) {`
    if ($arr[$i] -match "^\s*export function $fnName\(") { $start = $i; break }`
  }`
  if ($start -lt 0) { throw "Não encontrei $fnName()" }`
`
  for ($j=$start; $j -lt $arr.Length; $j++) {`
    if ($arr[$j] -match '^\s*\}\s*$') { $end = $j; break }`
  }`
  if ($end -lt 0) { throw "Não encontrei o fechamento de $fnName()" }`
`
  $before = if ($start -gt 0) { $arr[0..($start-1)] } else { @() }`
  $after  = if ($end -lt ($arr.Length-1)) { $arr[($end+1)..($arr.Length-1)] } else { @() }`
`
  return @($before + $newBlock + $after)`
}`

`
function Get-FunctionBlocksByName($text, $fnName) {`
  $needle = "function $fnName"`
  $list = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]`
  $i = 0`
`
  while ($true) {`
    $start = $text.IndexOf($needle, $i, [StringComparison]::Ordinal)`
    if ($start -lt 0) { break }`
`
    # acha a primeira "{"`
    $braceOpen = $text.IndexOf("{", $start)`
    if ($braceOpen -lt 0) { break }`
`
    # faz brace matching`
    $depth = 0`
    $end = -1`
    for ($k = $braceOpen; $k -lt $text.Length; $k++) {`
      $ch = $text[$k]`
      if ($ch -eq "{") { $depth++ }`
      elseif ($ch -eq "}") {`
        $depth--`
        if ($depth -eq 0) { $end = $k; break }`
      }`
    }`
    if ($end -lt 0) { break }`
`
    # inclui quebra de linha logo após (opcional)`
    $end2 = $end + 1`

// src/utils/ymd.js`
// ✅ Normalização CANÔNICA de datas (YMD) no frontend`
// - Converte Date/Timestamp para YMD em America/Sao_Paulo (não depende do timezone do usuário)`
// - Aceita ISO "YYYY-MM-DD..." e BR "DD/MM/YYYY"`
`
const TZ_SP = "America/Sao_Paulo";`
`
function pad2(n) {`
  return String(n).padStart(2, "0");`
}`
`
export function isYMD(s) {`
  return /^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})$/.test(String(s || "").trim());`
}`
`
export function dateToYMD_SP(d) {`
  if (!(d instanceof Date) || Number.isNaN(d.getTime())) return null;`
`
  try {`
    // en-CA => YYYY-MM-DD`
    const ymd = d.toLocaleDateString("en-CA", { timeZone: TZ_SP });`
    return isYMD(ymd) ? ymd : null;`
  } catch {`
    // fallback (não ideal, mas evita quebra total)`
    const y = d.getFullYear();`
    const m = pad2(d.getMonth() + 1);`
    const dd = pad2(d.getDate());`
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

// alias (se você preferir chamar sem sufixo depois)`
export const normalizeToYMD = normalizeToYMD_SP;`
'@ | Set-Content -Encoding UTF8 $utilPath`
`
"OK: criado/atualizado src/utils/ymd.js"`

    $inImport = $false`

    if ($line -notmatch '^\s*$' -and $line -notmatch '^\s*//') {`
      break`
    }`

}`

  const raw = String(v ?? "").trim();`

    .replace(/\s+/g, " ")`
    .trim();`
`

  if (key === "federal" || key === "fed" || key === "br" || key === "brasil") {`
    return "FEDERAL";`
  }`
`
  if (key === "rj" || key === "rio" || key === "pt_rio" || key === "pt-rio") {`
    return "PT_RIO";`

function Backup-File($p){`
  if (!(Test-Path $p)) { throw "Arquivo não encontrado: $p" }`

}`
`
function Replace-OrThrow($path, $pattern, $replacement, [string]$label){`
  $txt = Get-Content $path -Raw`
  $m = [regex]::Match($txt, $pattern, [Text.RegularExpressions.RegexOptions]::Singleline)`
  if (!$m.Success) { throw "Não encontrei padrão para: $label" }`
  $txt2 = [regex]::Replace($txt, $pattern, $replacement, 1, [Text.RegularExpressions.RegexOptions]::Singleline)`
  if ($txt2 -eq $txt) { throw "Replace não alterou nada em: $label" }`
  Set-Content -Encoding UTF8 $path $txt2`
  Write-Host "OK: aplicado -> $label"`
}`

function Replace-Once-OrThrow {`
  param(`
    [Parameter(Mandatory=$true)][string]$Path,`
    [Parameter(Mandatory=$true)][string]$Find,`
    [Parameter(Mandatory=$true)][string]$Replace,`
    [Parameter(Mandatory=$true)][string]$Label`
  )`
  $txt = Get-Content $Path -Raw`
  $idx = $txt.IndexOf($Find)`
  if ($idx -lt 0) { throw "Não encontrei para replace: $Label" }`
`
  $txt2 = $txt.Substring(0,$idx) + $Replace + $txt.Substring($idx + $Find.Length)`
  if ($txt2 -eq $txt) { throw "Replace não alterou nada: $Label" }`
`
  Set-Content -Encoding UTF8 $Path $txt2`
  Write-Host "OK: replace aplicado -> $Label"`
}`

function Fix-UseCallbackDeps-ByBlock {`
  param(`
    [Parameter(Mandatory=$true)][string]$Path,`
    [Parameter(Mandatory=$true)][string]$BlockStartRegex,`
    [Parameter(Mandatory=$true)][string]$DepsLineMustContainRegex,`
    [Parameter(Mandatory=$true)][string]$NewDepsLine`
  )`
`
  $lines = Get-Content $Path`
  $start = -1`
  for ($i=0; $i -lt $lines.Count; $i++) {`
    if ($lines[$i] -match $BlockStartRegex) { $start = $i; break }`
  }`
  if ($start -lt 0) { throw "Não achei bloco: $BlockStartRegex em $Path" }`
`
  $end = [Math]::Min($lines.Count-1, $start + 120)`
  $hit = -1`
  for ($i=$start; $i -le $end; $i++) {`
    if ($lines[$i] -match $DepsLineMustContainRegex) { $hit = $i; break }`
  }`
  if ($hit -lt 0) { throw "Não achei deps line (regex: $DepsLineMustContainRegex) perto de $BlockStartRegex em $Path" }`
`
  # preserva identação da linha atual`
  $indent = ""`
  if ($lines[$hit] -match "^(\s*)") { $indent = $Matches[1] }`
`
  $old = $lines[$hit]`

function Patch-NormKey([string]$FilePath, [string]$NewFunc, [switch]$FixConstAfterBrace) {`
  if (!(Test-Path $FilePath)) { throw "Arquivo não encontrado: $FilePath" }`
`
  $bak = $FilePath + ".bak_normKey_" + (Get-Date -Format "yyyyMMdd_HHmmss")`
  Copy-Item $FilePath $bak -Force`
  Write-Host "OK: backup -> $bak"`
`
  $txt = Get-Content $FilePath -Raw`
`
  $pattern = '(?s)function\s+normalizeLotteryKey\s*\([^)]*\)\s*\{.*?\n\}'`
  $re = [regex]::new($pattern)`
`
  if (-not $re.IsMatch($txt)) { throw "Não achei normalizeLotteryKey em $FilePath" }`
`
  $txt2 = $re.Replace($txt, $NewFunc, 1)`
`
  if ($FixConstAfterBrace) {`
    # garante quebra de linha depois do '}' antes de 'const express'`
    $txt2 = [regex]::Replace($txt2, '\}\s*const\s+express', "}`r`n`r`nconst express", 1)`
  }`
`
  Set-Content -Encoding UTF8 $FilePath $txt2`
  Write-Host "OK: patch aplicado -> $FilePath"`
}`
`
# ---- FUNÇÃO PADRÃO (rotas) RJ + FEDERAL only ----`

function normalizeLotteryKey(v) {`
  const s = String(v ?? "").trim().toUpperCase();`
`
  // RJ`
  if (s === "RJ" || s === "RIO" || s === "PT-RIO" || s === "PT_RIO") return "PT_RIO";`
`
  // FEDERAL`
  if (s === "FED" || s === "FEDERAL") return "FEDERAL";`

function pickScheduleForDate(schedule, ymd) {`
  if (!schedule || !ymd) return schedule;`
`
  const ranges = Array.isArray(schedule.ranges) ? schedule.ranges : null;`
  if (!ranges || !ranges.length) return schedule;`
`
  // ISO lexicográfico funciona (YYYY-MM-DD)`

    const rs = String(r?.start || "").trim();`
    const re = String(r?.end || "").trim();`
    if (rs && re && rs <= ymd && ymd <= re) return r;`
  }`

$idx1 = $block.IndexOf($needle)`

`
$idx2 = $block.IndexOf($needle, $idx1 + 1)`

/\bProcesso\b[\s\S]{0,40}\b(\d+\/\d{4})\b/i,`
'@`

$block2 = $block.Remove($idx2, $needle.Length).Insert($idx2, $replacement)`

$c2 = $c.Replace($block, $block2)`

  font-size: 13px;`
  font-weight: 750;`

}`
"@`

  # 1) remove linhas "soltas" que viraram expressão (causam no-unused-expressions)`
  # exemplos: "W", "660", "660;"`

    param($name)`
    $pattern = "(?s)(function\s+$name\s*\([^)]*\)\s*\{\s*)(?!const\s+W\s*=)"`

function toPercent(score) {`
  const n = Number(score);`
  if (!Number.isFinite(n)) return 0;`
`
  // Heurística: se vier 0..1, converte para 0..100`
  const pct = n <= 1 ? n * 100 : n;`
  return Math.max(0, Math.min(100, pct));`
}`

   - ordena por frequência desc (e desempate asc)`

`
function getDezenasFixasFromGrupo(grupo2) {`
  const g = Number(grupo2);`
  if (!Number.isFinite(g) || g < 1 || g > 25) return [];`
  // regra do JB: grupo 1 => 01..04, grupo 2 => 05..08, ..., grupo 14 => 53..56`
  const start = (g - 1) * 4 + 1; // 1,5,9,...,53...`
  const out = [];`
  for (let i = 0; i < 4; i += 1) {`
    out.push(String(start + i).padStart(2, "0"));`
  }`
  return out;`
}`

function toPercent(score) {`
  const n = Number(score);`
  if (!Number.isFinite(n)) return 0;`
  // Heurística: se vier 0..1, converte para 0..100`
  const pct = n <= 1 ? n * 100 : n;`
  return Math.max(0, Math.min(100, pct));`
}`
`
function formatGrupo(grupo) {`
  const g = Number(grupo);`
  if (!Number.isFinite(g) || g <= 0) return "—";`
  return String(Math.trunc(g)).padStart(2, "0");`
}`

@'`
const keyCart = (mesa) => `ga_cart_mesa_${String(mesa || "").trim()}`;`
`
export function readCart(mesa) {`
  try {`
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(keyCart(mesa));`
    const parsed = raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : { items: [] };`
    if (!parsed || !Array.isArray(parsed.items)) return { items: [] };`
    // sanitiza`
    return {`
      items: parsed.items`
        .filter(Boolean)`
        .map((x) => ({`
          id: String(x.id || ""),`
          nome: String(x.nome || ""),`
          preco: Number(x.preco || 0),`
          qtd: Math.max(1, Number(x.qtd || 1)),`
        }))`
        .filter((x) => x.id && x.nome),`
    };`
  } catch {`
    return { items: [] };`
  }`

function toPercent(score) {`
  const n = Number(score);`
  if (!Number.isFinite(n)) return 0;`
  const pct = n <= 1 ? n * 100 : n;`
  return Math.max(0, Math.min(100, pct));`
}`
`
function formatGrupo(grupo) {`
  const g = Number(grupo);`
  if (!Number.isFinite(g) || g <= 0) return "—";`
  return String(Math.trunc(g)).padStart(2, "0");`
}`
`
function normalizeMilharStr(v) {`
  const s = String(v || "").trim();`
  if (!s) return "";`
  const dig = s.replace(/\D+/g, "");`
  if (!dig) return "";`
  return dig.length >= 4 ? dig.slice(-4) : dig.padStart(4, "0");`
}`

@'`
const KEY = "ga_orders_v1";`
const EVT = "ga_orders_changed";`
`
function notify() {`
  try {`
    // Evento para a mesma aba (storage NÃO dispara no mesmo documento)`
    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent(EVT));`
  } catch {}`
}`
`
export function readOrders() {`
  try {`
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(KEY);`
    const arr = raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : [];`
    return Array.isArray(arr) ? arr : [];`
  } catch {`
    return [];`
  }`
}`
`
export function writeOrders(orders) {`
  try {`
    localStorage.setItem(KEY, JSON.stringify(Array.isArray(orders) ? orders : []));`
  } catch {}`
  notify();`
}`

export function getDowKey(ymd) {`

  if (!m) return NaN;`

  const d = Number(m[3]);`

function resolveComponent(mod, name) {`
  const isProbablyReactComponent = (x) =>`
    typeof x === "function" ||`
    (x && typeof x === "object" && String(x.$$typeof || "").includes("react."));`
`
  // 1) padrão: default -> mod`
  let c = mod?.default ?? mod;`
  if (isProbablyReactComponent(c)) return c;`
`
  // 2) fallback: procura exports nomeados que sejam componente`
  if (mod && typeof mod === "object") {`
    for (const k of Object.keys(mod)) {`
      if (k === "default") continue;`
      const v = mod[k];`
      if (isProbablyReactComponent(v)) {`
        // eslint-disable-next-line no-console`
        console.warn(`[IMPORT FALLBACK] ${name}: usando export nomeado '${k}'`);`
        return v;`
      }`
    }`
  }`
`
  // 3) última linha: devolve um componente "erro" em vez de quebrar a app inteira`
  // eslint-disable-next-line no-console`

function pad2(n){ return String(n).padStart(2,"0"); }`
`
function isYMD(s){`
  return /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(String(s||"").trim());`
}`
`
function ymdToDateUTC(ymd){`
  const m = String(ymd||"").match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})$/);`
  if(!m) return null;`
  return new Date(Date.UTC(Number(m[1]), Number(m[2])-1, Number(m[3])));`
}`
`
function addDaysUTC(ymd,days){`
  const dt = ymdToDateUTC(ymd);`
  if(!dt) throw new Error(`YMD inválido em addDaysUTC: ${ymd}`);`
  dt.setUTCDate(dt.getUTCDate()+Number(days||0));`
  return `${dt.getUTCFullYear()}-${pad2(dt.getUTCMonth()+1)}-${pad2(dt.getUTCDate())}`;`
}`

export function buildTimelineTop3({`
  ymd,`
  drawsToday,`
  drawsRange,`
  lotteryKey,`

    lotteryKey,`
    ymd: targetYmd,`
    PT_RIO_SCHEDULE_NORMAL,`
    PT_RIO_SCHEDULE_WED_SAT,`
    FEDERAL_SCHEDULE,`
  });`
`
  const normalizedSchedule = (Array.isArray(schedule) ? schedule : [])`
    .map(toHourBucket)`
    .filter(Boolean);`
`
  if (!normalizedSchedule.length) return [];`

  }`

  return ["09:00", "11:00", "14:00", "16:00", "18:00", "21:00"];`

    (h) => !gotHours.includes(h)`

`
function nowHHMMLocal() {`
  try {`
    const fmt = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-GB", {`
      timeZone: "America/Sao_Paulo",`
      hour: "2-digit",`
      minute: "2-digit",`
      hour12: false,`
    });`
    return fmt.format(new Date()).replace(".", ":");`
  } catch {`
    const d = new Date();`
    return `${pad2(d.getHours())}:${pad2(d.getMinutes())}`;`
  }`
}`
`
function addMinutesToHHMM(hhmm, minutes) {`
  const [h, m] = String(hhmm || "00:00").split(":").map(Number);`
  const total = (h * 60) + m + Number(minutes || 0);`
  const hh = Math.floor(total / 60);`
  const mm = total % 60;`
  return `${pad2(hh)}:${pad2(mm)}`;`
}`

@'`
export function normalizePhone(value) {`
  let digits = String(value || "").replace(/\D/g, "");`
`
  if (!digits) return "";`
`
  // já tem código do país`
  if (digits.startsWith("55") && digits.length >= 12) {`
    return digits.slice(0, 13);`
  }`
`
  // número brasileiro sem código do país`
  if (digits.length === 10 || digits.length === 11) {`
    return "55" + digits;`
  }`
`
  return digits.slice(0, 13);`
}`
`
export function isValidPhone(value) {`
  const digits = normalizePhone(value);`
  return digits.length >= 12 && digits.length <= 13;`
}`
`
export function formatPhone(value) {`
  const digits = normalizePhone(value);`
`
  if (!digits) return "";`
`
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  return "+" + digits;`
}`

$script = @'`

nova_funcao = r'''def classificar_tipo_documento(texto):`
    t = (texto or "").upper()`
`
    # Regra central:`
    # O tipo do documento principal tem prioridade sobre referências internas.`
    # Uma NF-e pode citar nota de empenho, processo, licitação ou contrato nas informações complementares.`
    if (`
        "DANFE" in t`
        or "NF-E" in t`
        or "NFE" in t`
        or "NOTA FISCAL" in t`
        or "NOTA FISCAL ELETRONICA" in t`
        or "NOTA FISCAL ELETRÔNICA" in t`
        or "CHAVE DE ACESSO" in t`
        or "DOCUMENTO AUXILIAR DA NOTA FISCAL" in t`
    ):`
        return "Nota Fiscal"`
`
    if "FICHA DE COMPENSAÇÃO" in t or "BOLETO" in t or "PAGAR PREFERENCIALMENTE" in t or "PAGÁVEL PREFERENCIALMENTE" in t:`

def replace_block(text, func_name, new_block):`
    pattern = rf"\ndef {func_name}\(.*?)(?=\ndef \w+\(|\n# =========================|\Z)"`
    new_text, n = re.subn(pattern, "\n" + new_block.rstrip() + "\n", text, flags=re.S)`
    if n == 0:`
        raise RuntimeError(f"Função não encontrada: {func_name}")`
    return new_text`

function readNormalized(path) {`
  const original = fs.readFileSync(path, "utf8");`
`
  return {`
    text: original.replace(/\r\n/g, "\n"),`
    eol: original.includes("\r\n") ? "\r\n" : "\n",`
  };`
}`
`
function writePreservingEol(path, text, eol) {`
  const output = eol === "\r\n"`
    ? text.replace(/\n/g, "\r\n")`
    : text;`
`
  fs.writeFileSync(path, output, "utf8");`
}`

    function Insert-AfterTrimmedLine {`
        param(`
            [Parameter(Mandatory)]`
            [string[]]$Lines,`
`
            [Parameter(Mandatory)]`
            [string]$Anchor,`
`
            [Parameter(Mandatory)]`
            [string[]]$InsertLines,`
`
            [Parameter(Mandatory)]`
            [string]$Label`

        pattern,`
        replacement,`
        text,`
        count=1,`
        flags=flags,`
    )`
`

            f"{label}: encontrado {count} vez(es). Esperado: 1."`
        )`

)`
